headline: Finger acquires manufacturer for 155 billion won, expanding into physical AI business
summary: Finger is acquiring a manufacturer of cooling equipment components and steel pipes for 155 billion won. The deal follows its earlier purchase of Mikelo Robotics and secures manufacturing sites for its physical AI push.
why: Physical AI combines robotics with AI software, and companies in this area are increasingly acquiring manufacturing capacity to build hardware at scale.
